name: Totaradale Golf Club
description: A tranquil 9-hole course on the outskirts of Wakefield village, a 15-minute drive south of Richmond.

name: Awatere Golf Club
description: Established in 1927, this friendly 9-hole club sits on the southern side of the Awatere River near Seddon in Marlborough. The course is open seven days a year and welcomes visitors to enjoy a relaxed round in a picturesque wine country setting.

name: Koura Bay Golf Course
description: A beautifully maintained 9-hole resort course set on a plateau at the foot of the ranges overlooking the North Kaikoura coast and peninsula. The course offers two tee-offs per hole for an 18-hole rating, with panoramic ocean views and a relaxed atmosphere.

name: Murchison Golf Club
description: A hidden gem near the Buller River, just 2 km north of Murchison in the Tasman region. This flat, relaxed 9-hole course offers a picturesque setting surrounded by native bush and mountain views.

name: Rarangi Golf Club
description: Nestled between the surf of Cloudy Bay and bush-clad hills dominated by Mount Robertson, Rarangi offers a unique all-seasons experience. Golfers can enjoy the rhythm of the surf, watch tui and fantails, and take in the bush-covered backdrop while playing a course that challenges all skill levels.

name: Redstone Golf Park
description: A charming 9-hole country course set in tranquil gardens, 30 minutes from Nelson near Wakefield. The flat layout features numerous water hazards and is welcoming to beginners, while experienced golfers will appreciate the challenge. An on-site cafe and disc golf course add to the relaxed atmosphere.

name: Wairau Valley Golf Club
description: A beautifully kept and picturesque rural 9-hole in the heart of the Marlborough region, 40 km southwest of Blenheim on SH 63. The course offers wonderful views of the nearby Richmond Range and features the infamous "Shady Lane" par 4.

name: Onekaka Links Golf Club
description: An extraordinary golfing experience in Golden Bay with stunning ocean vistas and memorable hospitality. The Links Course features one par 5, eight par 4s, and nine par 3s, incorporating double and triple greens, major elevation changes, cliffs, and penal bunkering. The Mountain Course adds a significantly tougher challenge for the adventurous golfer.

name: Tasman Golf Club
description: A spectacular course in Tasman village on the Kina Peninsula, off Highway 60 between Nelson and Motueka. The coastal setting provides beautiful views across Tasman Bay and the surrounding ranges.

name: Whataroa Golf Club
description: A picturesque 9-hole nestled in native bush on the West Coast, with a large creek winding through the course. Located near Franz Josef Glacier, it combines a unique golfing experience with the stunning scenery of South Westland.

name: Golden Downs Golf Club
description: Built in 1946, this parkland 9-hole near Wakefield boasts well-grassed fairways, excellent greens, and a serene bush setting that leaves visitors in awe. It is home to one of the longest par 5s in New Zealand at 659 metres from the black tees.

name: Marlborough Golf Club
description: Established in 1900 and situated among the vines, this is widely regarded as the finest golf course at the top of the South Island. Its long heritage and Marlborough wine country setting make it a must-play for visitors to the region.

name: Nopera Bay Golf Club
description: The only golf course in the Marlborough Sounds, set on a working farm in the Kenepuru Sound with staggering water and bush views. This remote 9-hole layout features challenging "risk and reward" holes with undulating terrain, sloping greens, and a deep creek running through the course.

name: Motueka Golf Club
description: A welcoming parkland course near Abel Tasman National Park, offering a pleasant round in one of New Zealand's sunniest regions. The lush surroundings and relaxed atmosphere make it a great stop for golfers exploring the Nelson Tasman area.

name: Wakefield Golf Club
description: A friendly rural 9-hole near the historic town of Wakefield in the Tasman region. The peaceful countryside setting and well-maintained layout provide an enjoyable round for golfers of all abilities.

name: Takaka Golf Club
description: A remote rural course in Golden Bay, offering a genuine backcountry golfing experience surrounded by lush farmland and mountain scenery. The relaxed pace and stunning setting make it a worthwhile detour for golfers exploring the top of the South Island.
